cohort: The study included 69 neonates born to COVID-19 positive mothers.
finding: A significant proportion of neonates born to COVID-19 positive mothers experienced preterm births and respiratory complications, although the risk of vertical SARS-CoV-2 transmission was low.
birth_weight: 60.9% of included neonates had a birth weight of less than 2.5 kg.
gest_age: Preterm births accounted for 42.0% of included neonates.
